content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION’ means all proprietary, technical, business, financial, and other information disclosed by Disclosing Party to Receiving Party, whether in written, oral, electronic, or other form.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION at all times and shall not disclose such information to any third party without the prior written consent of Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of March 2024.
